title: Summer $$2023$$ Midterm
body: Selected questions from the Summer $$2023$$ Midterm. Q4: We collect $$n$$ observations $$(x_i, y_i)$$ (one scalar feature $$x_i$$, $$one$$ $$scalar$$ $$target$$ $$y_i$$ each) and model each $$y_i$$ with one scalar parameter $$\theta$$: $$\hat{y}_i $$=$$ $$\operatorname{f_{\theta}}\left(x_i\right)$$ $$=$$ \theta\left(e**{\sqrt{|x_i|}}\right)$$. $$Q5$$: $$Kippa$$ $$obtains$$ $$a$$ $$dataset$$ $$of$$ $$players'$$ $$stats$$ $$with$$ $$columns$$ $$'Dis'$$ $$(total$$ $$distance$$ $$in$$ $$yards$$, $$a$$ $$float)$$, $$'League'$$ $$(a$$ $$string$$ $$with$$ $$only$$ $$two$$ $$values$$: $$La$$ $$Liga$$ $$or$$ $$Premier$$ $$League)$$, $$and$$ $$'Goals'$$ $$(average$$ $$goals$$ $$per$$ $$match$$, $$a$$ $$float)$$. $$A$$ $$subset$$ $$of$$ $$five$$ $$players$$ $$is$$ $$shown$$ $$below$$: $$\begin{array}{l|ccc$$} $$\text{Player$$} $$&$$ $$\text{Dis$$} $$&$$ $$\text{League$$} $$&$$ $$\text{Goals$$} $$\\$$ $$\hline$$ $$\text{Erling$$ $$Haaland$$} $$&$$ $$55.7$$ $$&$$ $$\text{Premier$$ $$League$$} $$&$$ $$1.373626$$ $$\\$$ $$\text{Harry$$ $$Kane$$} $$&$$ $$116.0$$ $$&$$ $$\text{Premier$$ $$League$$} $$&$$ $$0.745614$$ $$\\$$ $$\text{Robert$$ $$Lewandowski$$} $$&$$ $$122.6$$ $$&$$ $$\text{La$$ $$Liga$$} $$&$$ $$0.945946$$ $$\\$$ $$\text{Marcus$$ $$Rashford$$} $$&$$ $$148.4$$ $$&$$ $$\text{Premier$$ $$League$$} $$&$$ $$0.552764$$ $$\\$$ $$\text{Karim$$ $$Benzema$$} $$&$$ $$165.2$$ $$&$$ $$\text{La$$ $$Liga$$} $$&$$ $$0.775862$$ $$\end{array}$$
